key.name: super-key-opens-menu
key.description: A tap of Super opens Island Menu instead of GNOME's overview. The overview stays on the Activities button, the hot corner and Super+A.

key.name: menu-shortcut-enabled
key.description: Open the menu with the keyboard shortcut below.

key.name: menu-shortcut
key.description: The shortcut that opens the menu.

key.name: menu-show-panel-icon
key.description: A launcher button in the top bar.

key.name: menu-panel-icon
key.description: system: the logo of the system it runs on (Ubuntu's, Fedora's…), found on the system and drawn black or white as the bar's text is. grid: the app grid.

key.name: menu-switch-glass
key.description: The menu's own glass as a workspace switch slides under it (the menu kept open on empty workspaces), apart from Panel Island's setting for its glass. always: held still (blurred again once the switch is over), lightest on the CPU. battery: held still on battery only, live on mains. never: live, following the slide every frame. live-efficient: live, blurred at half resolution.

key.name: menu-clock
key.description: A clock at the left of the row under the hints, with the date, the next event of GNOME's calendar within the hour, and a moon with Do Not Disturb on. flip: flip digits, a changed digit flipping over. sun: the time beside a sun (or moon) on its arc across the day. off: none. It runs only while the menu is open.

key.name: menu-power-buttons
key.description: A row under the hints with a button for each power action GNOME allows now: lock, suspend, switch user, log out, restart and power off (restart and power off through GNOME's own dialog).

key.name: menu-search-position
key.description: top: the search field above its results (as before). bottom: the results above, then the hints, then the search field, nearest the launcher's bottom edge.

key.name: menu-highlight-style
key.description: How the focused search field and the chosen result look. classic: an accent ring round the field, the result tinted in the accent colour. lens: the field brighter with an accent line along its foot, the result on brighter glass with an accent bar and a bold name. capsule: a soft accent glow round the field, the result a solid accent pill. edge: the field only brighter, the result marked by an accent bar and a bold name, no fill.

key.name: menu-launcher-place
key.description: capsule: out of Panel Island's left capsule, its glass growing out of it (near the top without Panel Island), with the bar at the top or the bottom. capsule-middle: out of Panel Island's middle capsule (the clock's), centred on it, where it is shown; the left capsule where it is not (Isle's island holding the clock, the bar at the top). top-left: at the top left, under the top bar, coming down. top-middle: under the top bar, centred, coming down. centre: the middle of the screen, opening out from there. bottom-left, bottom-middle: at the bottom, rising up. These five have the launcher's own glass, and keep it clear of the bar.

key.name: menu-panel-icon-placement
key.description: Before or after the workspace buttons, or (centre) in the middle of the bar before the clock: in Panel Island's middle capsule, where that is shown. Hovering it there opens no workspace peek.

key.name: menu-default-search-engine
key.description: The engine "? query" searches with.

key.name: color-style
key.description: auto: light or dark as GNOME's own style is (Settings → Appearance). light: frosted light glass, dark text. dark: smoked glass, light text.

key.name: alt-tab-opens-menu
key.summary: Alt+Tab and Super+Tab open the menu
key.description: Alt+Tab and Super+Tab show the menu's open windows instead of GNOME's switchers: held, Tab steps through them, let go, the one chosen is gone to. Only the shortcut's handler inside the shell is changed, never a keyboard setting; turned off, GNOME's switcher has it again.

key.name: open-at-login
key.description: At login, the desktop with the menu open (Settings → At login: Island Menu). Overview or desktop at login is GNOME's own setting (org.gnome.shell start-in-overview), which the settings window sets.

key.name: open-on-empty-workspace
key.description: The menu opens by itself on a workspace with no windows (its last one closed, or an empty one gone to), and closes again as a window opens there. Not while Foresight Reborn, which opens the overview instead, is on.

key.name: menu-animations-enabled
key.description: The menu animates as it opens and closes.

key.name: menu-backdrop-dim-enabled
key.description: The screen behind the menu dims while it is open.

key.name: menu-enabled
key.description: Internal: the menu is on.

key.name: menu-trigger
key.description: Internal trigger the settings window uses to open the menu.

key.name: shelf-enabled
key.description: A shelf for files, folders, links and snippets you deliberately keep at hand ("# " in the menu).

key.name: shelf-show-in-menu
key.description: Show the Shelf's items and actions in the menu.

key.name: shelf-persist
key.description: Keep the Shelf's items after logging out.

key.name: shelf-max-items
key.description: How many items the Shelf keeps.

key.name: shelf-show-notifications
key.description: Notifications for what the Shelf does.

key.name: shelf-trigger-clear
key.description: Internal trigger the settings window uses to clear the Shelf.

key.name: shelf-imported
key.description: Internal: GNOME Essentials' Shelf has been copied over once.

key.name: uninstall-in-menu
key.description: An Uninstall action on apps found in the menu.

key.name: uninstall-enabled
key.description: Internal: uninstalling apps is available.

key.name: workspace-peek
key.description: The pointer resting on Panel Island's left capsule's workspace buttons grows it into glass with a live preview of each workspace: click one to go there, drag a window onto one to move it there.

key.name: workspace-numbers
key.description: Island Menu's own workspace buttons in Panel Island's left capsule, one per workspace: click one to go there, drop a window or an app icon on one.

key.name: drag-to-workspaces
key.description: A window moved by its title bar, or an app icon, held over Panel Island's left capsule opens the workspace peek; let go on a preview or a number, it goes to that workspace.

key.name: peek-delay
key.description: How long the pointer rests on a workspace button before the peek opens, in milliseconds.

key.name: attention-glow
key.description: Panel Island's left capsule's edge glows in the accent colour while a window on another workspace asks for attention.

key.name: glow-width
key.description: How wide the glowing line round the capsule is, in pixels; a soft glow reaches a little further in.

key.name: attention-pulse
key.description: The glow slowly breathes in and out instead of staying lit.

key.name: workspaces-imported
key.description: Internal: Panel Island's workspace settings (from before these features moved here) were brought over.
